name: Paul Saban Diccianni
headline: Solution Architecture Leader, Customer Success LATAM | AI & Cloud Transformation | Driving Business Growth @ Oracle
about:
I lead AI and Cloud Transformation initiatives across Latin America, helping organizations turn technology into tangible business outcomes.
 
With over 20 years of experience in enterprise architecture and solutioning, I specialize in bridging the gap between business strategy and technology execution—designing solutions that drive innovation, efficiency, and growth.
 
Today, my focus is on reimagining how enterprises leverage AI:
- Embedding AI into core business processes 
- Designing scalable, cross-cloud architectures 
- Driving value through AI-led transformation and modernization 
 
At Oracle, I work closely with customers, partners, and teams across the region to accelerate their journey—from foundational cloud adoption to advanced AI-driven innovation.
 
I’m particularly passionate about:
 
- Turning complex challenges into simple, actionable solutions 
- Enabling teams to scale impact through reusable architectures and best practices 
- Ensuring technology investments are aligned with measurable business value 
 
Always open to connecting with leaders exploring AI, cloud, and enterprise transformation.

experiences.position: Services Solutions Sr Director for Latin America, Customer Success Services
experiences.description:
I lead Solution Architecture for Oracle Customer Success Services across Latin America, driving its evolution into a strategic engine for business development and growth.
I work with sales, delivery, and customers to shape cloud and AI opportunities, design scalable architectures, and accelerate modernization across OCI, SaaS, and multicloud environments.
My focus is on embedding business value into every solution—ensuring technology translates into measurable outcomes.
I am also leveraging AI to enhance solutioning—scaling knowledge, accelerating proposals, and improving consistency across the region.
